'''Abyssal Ridge''' was a maritime battle area associated with one of the largest naval clashes of the later [[Solara-Khalindar War]].

== Battle ==

Old source material describes a major naval battle at the ridge after the war shifted from land operations to maritime attrition. Solaran fleets, including newly commissioned ships and carrier aircraft, fought a large Khalindarian naval force across several days.

Submarines, surface vessels, carrier aircraft, reconnaissance, and anti-ship strikes all shaped the engagement. Both sides suffered heavy losses, but neither achieved a decisive breakthrough.

== Role In The War ==

The battle showed the character of the mid-1992 to late-1994 phase: neither side could fully dominate the ocean between Solara and Khalindar, yet both had to keep fighting to protect supply routes, national prestige, and negotiating leverage.

The exact location of Abyssal Ridge on the map and the names of participating fleets need later confirmation before this page becomes a final map-heavy article.
